title: Music
tagline: Awards season, the big drops and the end-of-year lists.
subject: Pop culture

briefing.headline: The 2027 Grammy nominations were announced on 16 November, with Beyoncé setting a record of 100 career nominations.

points.text: The 2027 Grammy nominations were announced on 16 November. Several outlets covered the list and nominee reactions.
points.label: reported

points.text: Beyoncé has 100 career Grammy nominations, a record for the awards.
points.label: reported

points.text: Madonna is nominated in all four dance categories at the 2027 Grammys.
points.label: reported

points.text: Dolly Parton received a posthumous Grammy nomination. Miley Cyrus paid tribute to her.
points.label: reported

points.text: The 2026 CMA Awards are coming up. Predictions say Ella Langley may win most categories, but male vocalist may be safe from her.
points.label: opinion
